note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles). Guides are this entry's own words, each citing its sources.

KG.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. It is the last trophy by definition, so treat the roadmap's three stages as the path to it: story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission — play through it and the trophy pops at the end. No mission replay exists, but story trophies cannot be missed: they unlock as the plot advances.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops at the chapter's end. Before the chapter closes, do the one thing that can be lost: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy), and keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 2 to its end. The story runs five chapters and takes roughly 60–80 hours in total, so this is a long-haul trophy, not a grind.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3. One early guide warns a Chapter 3 side mission, Race Against Yago, may expire if left sitting — start it as soon as it appears, even though it is not itself a trophy.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4. By now most of the activity trophies will have started ticking over on their own — check the Progress menu (Touch Pad, then Progress) to see what is already counting.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish the final mission and the gold pops. After it you return to free roam, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats, and everything still needed stays available — nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when the story hands it to you. Mission names in the hidden list are spoilers, which is why the spoiler setting hides this trophy until you earn it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions also teach the robbery mechanics that the later bank-vault and armored-truck trophies build on.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Child's Play. No preparation needed — just play the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Headliners. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter anyway: there is no mission replay, and a chapter-start save is the only way back if you want to redo a story beat.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy happens — you will know the layout by then.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. With it, the last of the hidden story trophies is done — the remaining hidden trophies are all side content, not plot.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy. After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist. It is far kinder than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and collectibles are only partly required. What it does demand is every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and the Bret quest, plus scanning 200 of the 277 base vehicle models, studying 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, and 70 of 80 Challenges. Budget around 100 hours for this stage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps and airtime while driving — they rack up naturally across 200 hours of play, but you can grind them in free roam after the story by chaining jumps off ramps and hills. The Progress menu tracks your count, so check it before grinding: you may already be most of the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in the game. Try one of each — fishing, hunting, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and meditation are among them. Sample them as they appear during the story and this pops early; the Progress menu shows which types you have tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges across Leonida, and every one needs a gold medal. The guides call the golds forgiving rather than brutal — learn each drill's timing, replay the ones you miss, and clear them range by range. All 42 are also required for 100% completion, so this is not optional for the platinum.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations. Win one race at each — you do not need to win every race, just one per location. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so knock them out during the cleanup stage and tick them off here as you go.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events — each distinct race counts once, so variety matters more than repeats. Races span street, off-road, boat and air events across Leonida. They stay open in free roam after the story, so save the grind for cleanup if you like.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types: cast, watch the line tension, and reel him in without snapping the line. The challenge is repeatable, so a lost round costs nothing but time.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet — bars and arcades around Vice City have them — and play any game through to its end. One full completion is all it takes; pick the shortest game on the cabinet.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the stranger characters with a mission strand. Follow his chain to its final mission and complete it. Stranger quest givers can go temporarily unavailable during the story — do not worry, every trophy-related character is back in free roam after the ending.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's strand ends with his final mission. Kenton is one of the quest givers the guides specifically flag as temporarily unavailable mid-story, so if his icon vanishes, keep playing — he returns in free roam and his strand can be finished then.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand ends with his final mission. Like the other stranger chains, it is a sequence of missions from his icon on the map — clear them in order and the trophy pops at the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands. Strangers show as purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters, on the map. The five named stranger trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight — finish three more strands and the silver pops. None of it is required for 100% completion, so this is a stage-3 cleanup job.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand ends with his final mission. Work his missions in order from his map icon; the chain is self-contained, and like every stranger strand it can be finished in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's strand ends with his final mission. Five stranger trophies plus three more strands make the Strangers & Freaks silver — Tyrone is one of the five, so his chain pulls double duty.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS. There are 18 meditation spots, and the first is only available in Chapter 1: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia says in the kitchen at Jason's house that she is going to meditate, then walks to the balcony. Follow her and choose Accept — she teaches you, and it adds 1 to the counter. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it. The other spots are marked meditation spots around Leonida. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1 as insurance.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret sends you after a unique animal. Track it with the hunting tools — study animals through binoculars first, since studying 100 of the 255 animals also feeds the 100% checklist. The Bret quest is one of the few side strands the 100% checklist actually requires, so do not skip it.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: There are 18 collectible card sets hidden across Leonida. Complete any 3 full sets and the silver pops. For 100% completion you need 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting past the trophy — the same hunt serves both.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations across Leonida. The same app scans vehicles, so make a habit of it: every time you see a new vehicle or a marked spot, WAiNK it. The count builds steadily through the story and cleanup; there is no shortcut, just coverage.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 Challenges in the game and the trophy needs 50 of them. The 100% checklist needs 70, so you can skip the hardest 10 entirely. Work through the easy and medium ones first — stunt, driving and combat challenges overlap with what you are already doing.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, get out of the search area, and hide until the stars clear — countryside roads and tunnels help. Do it during a story stretch when your partner is with you, or it will not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level alive the whole time — the trick is not losing the cops between shops. Pick three shops close together, move fast from one to the next, and do not let the stars drop. If the wanted level clears, the chain resets and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning new ones with the WAiNK app as you drive. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base vehicle models scanned, so keep the habit all game: every new model you pass is progress toward both the trophy and the checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus — the slow-motion targeting mode — in a firefight with a group of enemies, and drop 5 before it ends. Pick a mission or shootout with clustered enemies, wait until several are in view, then activate it and chain the kills. If you fall short, it is repeatable in the next fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, get to a plane on the tarmac, and take off without a scheduled flight — steal one and leave. Expect a wanted level on the way out; the trophy is about the departure itself, so just get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description points at the Rhino tank. Early guides tie this trophy to getting into a Rhino — they appear at the military base and in the response to high wanted levels — and using it. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by guides, so grab a Rhino when the chance comes and put it through its paces.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without a single detection: no alarms tripped, no witness spotting you. Go in quiet at a quiet hour, move slowly, use stealth takedowns on anyone in the way, and get out before the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — a failed attempt does not lock you out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape the wanted level after each one. The 100% checklist needs 8 bank vault robberies, so keep going past the trophy — same job, more of it. Plan the escape before you go in: a fast car parked close by makes the getaway far easier.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes on the roads of Leonida. Hit one — force it to stop, grab the cash — then lose the wanted level and escape. Trucks respawn on their routes, so if one gets away or the job goes wrong, wait for the next.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited — mop up the corners you never had a mission in during the cleanup stage, especially the rural edges and the Keys. Drive through each one and it counts.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, and you need to rob an illegal operation belonging to each one. Gang operations are also on the 100% checklist — 39 of them in total — so the trophy is a milestone on the way to a bigger job, not a separate grind.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach and enjoy a cocktail with the view. Early reports point at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar — order a cocktail there. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by guides, so if the first bar does not pop it, try the other beachfront spots.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car out through a vehicle showroom's glass front — the classic smash-and-grab exit. Early guides list this among the trophies whose exact trigger is still being confirmed, so pick a showroom, get a car inside, and go out through the window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game of bowling, follow-through and all. Bowling is one of the 9 activity types, so this also ticks a box for Master of None.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a partnership with mass appeal. Early guides list this among the trophies whose exact trigger is still being confirmed, most likely a moment with your partner that lands with a crowd. This guide will not invent a method: check back as the guides pin it down.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count to 500 for this one: choices made across the game, for better or worse. There is no single moment to chase — keep playing, keep choosing, and the counter builds over a full playthrough. It should pop naturally long before the platinum.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The name says it: succeed at something on the second attempt, after failing once. Early guides have not pinned the exact trigger yet — it is likely tied to a specific retryable moment rather than any failure. This guide will not invent a method: check back as the guides confirm it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's oddity moment. The description reads like an easter egg or a weird world event, and early guides have not confirmed the exact trigger. Keep an eye on the strangest corners of Leonida; this guide will not invent a location.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack while driving past — a melee drive-by. Approach on a bike or in a slow car, swing as you pass, and connect. Any pedestrian counts; pick a quiet street so the wanted level stays manageable.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies. Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Robberies feed the pile steadily — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations all pay in marked bills — so this climbs on its own while you chase the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, vehicles, everything counts toward the one total. Do not grind it early: it adds up naturally over a full playthrough, and by the cleanup stage you will be most of the way there. If it is the last one standing, buy a car.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. They unlock as you progress — check the property icons on the map and buy each one when you can afford it. Garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so the two trophies pair up.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app and register 10 vehicles. Any vehicles you own or find can be registered — the count is about registrations, not rare finds. Pair it with the garage hunt: buy a garage, park a vehicle, register it, repeat.
